chat/messages/create-to-user.note: 3 秒後の newChatMessage（main / Web Push）は mk-jobs の delaySeconds で送る。既読判定は Redis マーカーの代わりに chat_message.reads 列で、会話チャンネル購読中の受信者は既読扱い（クライアントの read フレームを hub が PG に書けないため）。
chat/messages/create-to-user.noteEn: The newChatMessage (main / Web Push) after 3 seconds is sent with mk-jobs delaySeconds. Read state is determined from the chat_message.reads column instead of a Redis marker, and a recipient subscribed to the conversation channel is treated as having read it (because the hub cannot write the client's read frame to PG).
chat/messages/create-to-user.summary: 既読判定を PostgreSQL の列で行う
chat/messages/create-to-user.summaryEn: Read state is tracked in a PostgreSQL column

chat/messages/create-to-room.note: 3 秒後の newChatMessage（main / Web Push）は mk-jobs の delaySeconds で送る。既読判定は Redis マーカーの代わりに chat_message.reads 列で、ルームチャンネル購読中の受信者は既読扱い（クライアントの read フレームを hub が PG に書けないため）。
chat/messages/create-to-room.noteEn: The newChatMessage (main / Web Push) after 3 seconds is sent with mk-jobs delaySeconds. Read state is determined from the chat_message.reads column instead of a Redis marker, and a recipient subscribed to the room channel is treated as having read it (because the hub cannot write the client's read frame to PG).
chat/messages/create-to-room.summary: 既読判定を PostgreSQL の列で行う
chat/messages/create-to-room.summaryEn: Read state is tracked in a PostgreSQL column

chat/history.note: isRead は Redis マーカーではなく chat_message.reads 列から算出。ルームの未読はメッセージ到着時ではなく取得時に判定するため、後からミュートしたルームは未読にならない。
chat/history.noteEn: isRead is computed from the chat_message.reads column rather than a Redis marker. A room's unread state is determined at fetch time rather than when the message arrives, so a room muted later does not become unread.
chat/history.summary: 既読判定を PostgreSQL の列で行う
chat/history.summaryEn: Read state is tracked in a PostgreSQL column
